pr_body:
This is a new PR introducing configuration cache compliant build finish logic. In addition to the original PR it addresses dealing with large file paths (mainly failing on windows) correctly. 

Example pipeline including running on windows: https://buildkite.com/elastic/elasticsearch-pull-request/builds/761
 
Fixes #102022
pr_title: Fix creation of large build job archives

review_comment: Hmm, I'm not sure we should consider this an input since we're just using it to register scan links. Does `@Internal` work here?
this must be @Input. Everything else is not supported. Even though error messages in gradle are misleading
Interesting. I'm surprised that's even serializable. This might bite us later.
